newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-WEEKEND'S GERMAN FIRST DIVISION MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND'S GERMAN FIRST DIVISION MATCHES.

text.p: Matches in the German first division this weekend (league positions in brackets):

Hansa Rostock (15) v St Pauli (14) kickoff 1730 GMT Both teams struggling close to relegation zone and points are vital. Rostock expected to name unchanged team with new defender Thomas Gansauge still in the line-up. St Pauli expected to select defender Holger Stanislawski after influenza.

Werder Bremen (5) v Bayer Leverkusen (3) 1800 GMT Neither team can afford to lose points to stay with leaders. Bremen worried about German international midfielder Marco Bode who has influenza. Leverkusen probably unchanged apart from defensive midfielder Carsten Ramelow.

Borussia Dortmund (4) v Arminia Bielefeld (18) Dortmund should win against newly-promoted team yet to win away this season. Reigning champions, without wing-back Stefan Reuter (suspended), must wait on Brazilian defender Julio Cesar (knee injury). Bielefeld expected to name Dutchman Sonny Silooy at libero.

UEFA Cup campaigners Hamburg need better form in Bundesliga. Northerners worried about striker Karsten Baeron who has influenza. Karlsruhe expected to be defensive with South African Sean Dundee as only striker.

VfB Stuttgart (1) v Borussia Moenchengladbach (10) Stuttgart have most players fit but struggled at times in 2-0 German Cup victory over unglamorous Zwickau in midweek. Former German international Thomas Berthold could return after thigh injury. Visitors missing key playmaker Stefan Effenberg (calf and back injuries).
1860 have defensive problems but hope to welcome back Bernhard Winkler up front after stomach illness. Duisburg have not won away this season.

Polish forward Richard Cyron expected to return for Fortuna who have bad home record, winning just one of five games. Bayern still waiting to see if international midfielders Thomas Strunz and Mario Basler fit.
Cologne without midfielder Sunday Oliseh who on international duty for Nigeria. Schalke concerned about striker Martin Max (calf injury)
Freiburg big disappointment so far but won third round German Cup clash with Meppen 2-1 during week. Bochum expected to bring back Bulgarian forward Georgi Donkov.
